items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: Went with Bill Grauer. Quite often we were classmates at Columbia.

ctx.x: Did you go there several times?
Went there quite often. Went with Bill Grauer. Quite often we were classmates at Columbia. And then went the, uh, following year when Don Ullo was there. Mm.
So you did get a good impression of it?
